headline: Your week's dinners, from the plan to the plate.

slots.aside: **What travels:** the recipe, what to buy, how long it takes, who it serves and your own notes.

notes.title: How it works
notes.text: Save the recipes you love. Ask for ideas when you are stuck. Every Monday at 8 the app plans the week and writes the shopping list.

notes.title: What you get
notes.text: Your recipe box, a page for each recipe, a form for new ones, the week's plan and your settings.

notes.title: Your account
notes.text: Sign in with your own account and pay by card. The weekly plan arrives by email.
